documents.t: Worked examples — executed notebooks rendered as pages (refreshed weekly against the live APIs): Quickstart

sportsdataverse.hockey.nl — 17 endpoints. Note: robots.txt on www.nationalleague.ch disallows /api. The owner approved building on it on 2026-10-12 for polite, incremental use: requests are spaced at least 1 s apart, and a bulk backfill or a published mirror needs the owner's sign-off first. Note: Crawl incrementally: fetch a finished game once (keyed by game_id), find new games with one nl_schedule call per run, and fetch season tables at most once per game day.
documents.s: NL — National League app API (www.nationalleague.ch/api, Switzerland)
